status: Complete built resource/command contract passed after volume integration; native, account and platform qualification retain their recorded scopes

shared_UI.behavior: Observe only the original terminal command while native settlement remains pending. Recheck the complete workspace recovery scope before enabling saves. Never replay or acknowledge a command.
shared_UI.limits: One cancellable observer per project, compact reads every500ms, 30s observation bound with existing manual recovery fallback. Reject late replies after account, folder, host, project or ticket changes.

native_callbacks.behavior: A verified command address belongs to the retained command record, independently of its file journal. Dynamic command recovery and final metadata settlement follow that address.
native_callbacks.compatibility: Records without an independent address keep their original owner callback. Verified reconnection atomically upgrades private schema to12, including earlier settlement/audit tables; earlier readers fail closed.
native_callbacks.authority: Namespace, original command, worker proof, invocation and previous verified callback are rechecked. File identity, file callback, command outcome and execution authority do not change.

application.cases: Original review and session identity; ordered resource operations and undo; durable language review; interruption after a real primitive; native restart, reload and original-folder regrant; newer draft preservation; command-only and combined approval; lost dispatch without replay; same-window Stop; uncertain outcomes; draft persistence; rollback before command claim; admitted Prepared cancellation.
application.transport: Fault-injection file execution, paired command journal and verified reconnect all use the same real relaying proxy; production callback identity checks are unchanged.

remaining: Fresh physical Chrome/PWA folder-permission checks and complete optimized-distribution qualification retain their own scope; Local OPFS is not physical permission evidence.
Full local CI remains a separate required pre-publication gate; these records describe scoped native/application checks.

Local_folder_regrant.behavior: Use the saved per-project path only as a hint when the original physical identity is known. Retain permission/current-scope checks and the existing native Open(expected), fresh browser challenge read and Prove sequence. No ordinary command admission is weakened.

qualification_scope: The current Mac app runs the original Local/Remote resource and command assertions with the same deadlines. Native restart, regrant, rollback, lost dispatch, Stop, drafts and command non-replay pass. No fresh physical-folder or complete optimized-distribution claim.

historical_Chrome.stale_cases: Real authentication generation and OPFS/Remote root changes reject deferred compact responses without relying on an artificial UI status change.

source_scope.source_difference: Only a justified cfg_attr(not(macos), allow(clippy::unused_self, reason=...)) annotation was added to has_persistent_volume. Runtime logic and API are unchanged; original Mac checks were not rerun or relabeled.
